shared_elements: low-relief carving on natural stone surface
stone monument photographed in situ against sky
justification: Both are stone surfaces bearing shallow relief carvings that include a rounded disc/spiral and hook-beaked profile creatures with strongly curvilinear outlines, which is the most specific correspondence. But A's motifs sprawl irregularly over a dark, weathered boulder with no ordering, whereas B's are disciplined into stacked horizontal registers on a dressed pale rectangular pillar, with crisper, more legible animal forms — so the manner and composition are quite different.
